subject: Proposed subprocessor inventory & attenuation plan recon for EdgeBridge
messages:
From: Marin Patel <marin.patel@vaulttech.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@vaulttech.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry: planned addition of EdgeBridge as telemetry subprocessor

Hi David,

Quick one from our side — we received notice from our infra team that Redwood is planning to integrate EdgeBridge (edgebridge.io) to handle telemetry enrichment for a pilot connecting EU customers to a new CDN leg. Before we sign off, Legal and our Security team need a short inventory and an assessment of impact to residency and transfer controls. Specifically can you provide:

- A short subprocessor manifest for EdgeBridge (roles, jurisdictions, subprocessed data types)
- Whether EdgeBridge will: have access to unredacted request payloads, store logs persistently, or export to any non-EU regions
- Proposed DPA addendum text or pointer and evidence (SOC2 / encryption in transit at minimum)
- If there is an onshore fallback (onshore routing or alternative processor) and the activation criteria

We are on a tight window — pilot goes live week of Aug 2. If you can share an initial package by EOD Friday (Jul 23) that would be ideal.

Best,
Marin
Marin Patel
Head of Infrastructure Operations, VaultTech
marin.patel@vaulttech.com

[Attachment: vendor-notice-EdgeBridge-07-21.pdf (stub)]

From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: Marin Patel <marin.patel@vaulttech.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: planned addition of EdgeBridge as telemetry subprocessor

Hi Marin — thanks for the heads-up and the clear checklist. Looping in Kimberly (Privacy) and Marissa (Procurement) to pull the DPA addendum and evidence together. Quick answers up front to reduce blockers:

- Role & scope: EdgeBridge will be acting as a telemetry enrichment and transient logging processor for our edge telemetry pipeline. They will not be a persistent storage provider for customer payloads — logs are kept for a rolling 14-day diagnostic window and truncated to metadata for general observability.
- Residency: The EdgeBridge processing nodes for the EU pilot are in Frankfurt (DE) and Amsterdam (NL). No planned export to the US for telemetry events unless explicit routing fallback occurs.
- Access: EdgeBridge will see request metadata and enriched telemetry (no PII fields we expect to be present in payloads). We will apply our payload scrubbing step prior to forwarding.
- Onshore fallback: We do have an onshore fallback route that pins EU traffic to our dedicated onshore pool in Frankfurt; activation is policy-based (latency threshold or failure-rate > 5% over 10 minutes).

Kimberly — can you attach the DPA addendum draft and the SOC2 summary? Marissa — can you confirm commercial terms / activation notice window for rolling EdgeBridge out to production? Marin, I'll get the dataflow diagram and a short manifest attached in the next message.

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

[Internal note: we need to ensure scrubbing logic excludes raw user prompts before send; engineering ticket CR-4791 created.]

From: Marin Patel <marin.patel@vaulttech.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@vaulttech.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: planned addition of EdgeBridge as telemetry subprocessor

David — thanks, that helps. A couple of follow-ups from Security / Legal:

1) Can you confirm whether the 14-day window includes raw request bodies that might contain customer-submitted content? If so, we need to see redaction rules and examples.
2) Please attach any third-party attestations (SOC2 Type II report or ISO27001 cert). If public reports are limited, a short attestation letter is fine.
3) For the fallback trigger, we need a runbook extract — what automated signals trigger the onshore reroute, and how quickly would the switch complete?

We can accept a partial package by Friday and the remaining items early next week — legal is primarily worried about the potential for request-body retention.

Regards,
Marin

[Attachment: vt-security-checklist.xlsx (stub)]

From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Marin Patel <marin.patel@vaulttech.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeBridge follow-ups / action items (internal summary)

Team — summary and action items from the VaultTech thread (they requested a package by EOD Jul 23):

1) DPA addendum draft: Kimberly to prepare a short addendum that enumerates scope (telemetry enrichment), retention (14 days rolling), and limited export clauses. Please include a specific clause that Redwood performs scrubbing of request bodies before forwarding; include examples of redaction rules. (owner: kimberly_park, due: 2027-07-22 17:00 PDT)

2) Evidence: attach our latest SOC2 summary and EdgeBridge public attestations (owner: kimberly_park to gather; if EdgeBridge cannot provide full reports, request an attestation letter). (due: 2027-07-23 12:00 PDT)

3) Dataflow diagram & manifest: I will attach a dataflow PNG and brief manifest for EdgeBridge (roles, locations, data types). Also include the engineering ticket CR-4791 that enforces scrubbing prior to forward. (owner: david_kim, due: 2027-07-22 12:00 PDT)

4) Procurement/commercial: Marissa to confirm activation notice window and cost impact for enabling EdgeBridge in production; confirm rollback SLA & notice to customer. (owner: marissa_cole, due: 2027-07-22 17:00 PDT)

5) Runbook extract for onshore fallback: engineering to provide a short excerpt describing automated signals and expected failover time (owner: SRE on call; please coordinate with Marissa for communication). Aim: failover < 3 minutes for automated signals; manual escalation procedure documented.

Marin — we'll push the initial partial package (dataflow + manifest + DPA draft) by EOD Jul 22 and the full evidence bundle by Jul 23. If there are any hard blockers from Legal, loop Kimberly and I immediately.

-David

[Attachments to follow: edgebridge_processor_spec_v1.pdf, dataflow-diagram-edgebridge.png]
